source.scope: Original contact probe block 0x4a6a25..0x4a6c01 executes intact, using 0x4b8660 transforms and 0x411340 smooth terrain queries. Inputs use varied affine transforms and synthetic local probe points over the supplied terrain; incoming selector is preserved as in the original. This is not a full bike-step comparison. Terrain nodes are loaded through original 0x48a2f0. Host stdio/allocation and child object construction replace runtime services; renderer initialization is omitted. Root offset, scales and decompressed banks are supplied by the recovered prefix reader, not independently loaded by the full game.
